tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Search for bookable experiences in a specific city with city fallback matching and optional date filtering.

tools.name: search_by_mood
tools.description: Search by emotional intent, mapping moods like romantic, relaxing, foodie, or rainy_day to optimized search filters before running a city search.

tools.name: find_nearby_experiences
tools.description: Find experiences near a geographic location using latitude, longitude, radius, and optional date filtering.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Browse supported cities with optional filtering and result limits.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Quick date-specific availability check for one experience, including party pricing, booking URL, and Ghost Checkout payload metadata.

tools.name: get_experience_details
tools.description: Get detailed availability, pricing, venue, and image information for a specific tickadoo experience using a slug or booking path.

tools.name: compare_experiences
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 experiences side-by-side with winner callouts for best value, highest rated, most popular, and family fit.

tools.name: get_transfer_info
tools.description: Estimate taxi, tube/metro, bus, and train transfers from a city's default airport, station, or port to hotel coordinates.

name: io.github.tickadoo/tickadoo-mcp
title: tickadoo — Experiences & Events
